title: R' Yishmael ben Yehotzadak

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Bava Metzia 22b (Hyman cites 22a)](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Metzia.22b.5), where R’ Yohanan speaks in his name; but Hyman calls this a scribal error and says it should read R' Shimon ben Yehotzadak, as in the Rosh and Dikdukei Soferim.[^1]

notes.text: The linked passage has Rabbi Yochanan speak in Rabbi Yishmael ben Yehotzadak’s name. Hyman proposes Shimon and cites the Rosh and Dikdukei Soferim. [Heilprin’s Yishmael headword](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2267&lang=en) refers the reader to Shimon.
